items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: Like, “Did you hear Freddie Hubbard’s last record” or this or that.

ctx.x: How did you guys pass your time during all that travel on the bus?

Oh, we would talk a lot about music and players you know. Like, “Did you hear Freddie Hubbard’s last record” or this or that. You know. Then we had a little battery-driven record player on the bus for a while. It was like a little — it was a piece of junk man, I think it was made in Taiwan or something. I don’t know. But yeah then we’d sleep. We’d try to sleep man. You know. Because we’d get in at maybe five in the morning and check in man. Leave the gig, you know, get on the bus, try to sleep and then check in…
I don’t think that’s an experience young jazz players get these days.
